run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum sum of pairs with difference less than k in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets and print success count
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that greedily pairs adjacent sorted elements with difference less than k
